preprocessing.scope: 5,143 source photographs; 5,150 attempts including retries. Includes the 26.295-second model load.
Scoring elapsed includes loading, image/text scoring and embeddings export; excludes final filtering and selection.

preprocessing.stage: Final filtering, redundancy, diversity and K selection
preprocessing.scope: NOT MEASURED separately. Do not treat the scorer timer as the entire filtering pipeline.
preprocessing.hardware: Not established for this complete boundary

preprocessing.scope: NOT MEASURED on a complete comparable boundary. Source acquisition and other preparation overheads are missing.

notes: All three frozen routes inherit the Stage O filtered-photo selection lineage. Qwen-Image does not read captions in its Visual pass, but the 73 selected image IDs come from that preparation.
BLIP-2 processed 5,143 source photographs; Qwen-Image generation used 73 selected photographs. These are different workload sizes.
Allocated VRAM is PyTorch allocator memory, not total device memory or minimum hardware capacity. Sequential-stage peaks are maxima, not sums.
LED has a recorded BLIP-stage peak of 4.168 GiB versus 2.697 GiB for summary generation. CPU-offload RAM and complete-pipeline capacity are not established.
Prepared-input timing is descriptive for these implementations. It does not establish end-to-end superiority, equal summary quality, or an architecture-only speed effect.
